name: Three-Point Lighting with Mood Tint
description: Classic key + fill + rim lighting setup, with the fill light tinted toward the cartridge's emotional palette to set mood without crushing readability.
when_to_use: Any cinematic, intro, or close-up scene; also works for portrait-style menus.
conceptual_steps: Place key light 30-45° off camera axis, intensity 1.0.
Place fill light opposite the key, intensity 0.3-0.5, tinted toward the emotional palette (e.g. magenta for tension, soft amber for calm).
Place rim light behind the subject, intensity 0.8, slightly cooler than key for separation.
Adjust shadow softness so the key cast shadow is crisp and the fill cast shadow is barely visible.
tradeoffs: Three real-time lights is fine on desktop; bake to lightmaps for mobile-tier hardware.
